Disk full → DB write failed → api killed itself, never restarted.

- 03:05:00–03:12:48: `job=report-export` writes 40 × 512 MB parts (~20 GB) to `/var/lib/stockroom/exports/`, the same volume as the DB.
- 03:09:03: `disk /var/lib/stockroom at 91%`; 03:13:30: 99%.
- 03:14:00: `ERROR db: could not extend file "base/16384/2619": No space left on device`
- 03:14:03: `ERROR api: transaction aborted, shutting down worker pool`
- 03:14:06: `FATAL api: exiting (status 1)`
- 03:16:00 onward: `proxy: upstream api refused connection` every 2 min, 67 times, last at 05:28:00.

Last successful api request was 03:13:51 (id=001477). Log ends 05:29:57 with api still down → outage of at least 2h16m, with no restart attempt logged. Proxy and web kept serving 200s throughout.

The export job logs no completion or failure line; it just stops after part-01456, so it probably died on ENOSPC too. Its parts are likely still on disk, in which case api will fail again on restart until they're cleared.

The `cache: slow command` warnings (100–148 ms) run at the same rate before and after the crash, so they're unrelated.

Log timestamps are 2026-03-09, not last night (today is 2026-10-08), and CLAUDE.md calls `logs/` sample logs → confirm this is the right file for the incident you mean.

Nothing in the repo references `report-export`, so the job is defined elsewhere; I couldn't check why it wrote that much.

Separately: the chisle plugin's statusline badge isn't configured. Say so if you want me to add it to `settings.json`.
